name: National-anarchism
summary: National-anarchism is a far-right current that combines racial and ethnic separatism with opposition to the state and capitalism. It proposes replacing nation-states and global institutions with self-sufficient, ethnically or tribally defined autonomous communities, drawing on Julius Evola's traditionalism, distributism, green anarchism and primitivism. Scholars largely treat it as a rebranding of fascism or the radical right, while adherents present it as voluntary separatism.
scope: The Troy Southgate strand (National Revolutionary Faction, Black Front Press, National-Anarchist Movement) as documented by Macklin and others, with Richard Hunt, Evola and Jünger as influences. It excludes Keith Preston's pluralist 'pan-secessionism' and Thilo Kabus's separate 'Anarcho-Nationalism'. Many positions are inferred from anti-statism and traditionalism because the movement has little detailed policy, so many answers are low confidence.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Rejects state provision; healthcare would be handled by self-sufficient local communes, not a taxing state.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Wage law presupposes a state and market labor; inferred from the stateless, communal, self-sufficient economy proposal.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Anti-capitalist and anti-globalist, favoring mutualist local economies over free markets, though it also rejects state planning.

public-ownership.rationale: Opposes the state, so state ownership of industry is rejected; common ownership is meant at commune or guild level.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Opposes the state as taxer; inferred from stateless commune model, though it is hostile to financiers.

unions-good.rationale: Hostile to class war and to Marxism; guild-style bodies appear in Southgate's distributism but unions as such are not endorsed.

property-fundamental.rationale: Southgate favored guild common ownership and collective maintenance of land, so strong individual property rights are not central.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Wants corporations and capitalism supplanted by localism, not regulated by a state it rejects.

cut-welfare.rationale: Opposes the state but also dependency on global capitalism; welfare is simply replaced by communal mutual aid, so adherents give no clear answer.

worker-ownership.rationale: Southgate's guild/distributist common ownership of production points to collective ownership, though he later dropped socialist trappings.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Opposes the state and its security apparatus; inferred from anti-statism and clandestine-cell tactics.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Southgate says he does not seek to police private conduct outside NA communities, but communal norms are traditionalist; no clear stance.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: A stateless ideology of racial separatism rejects legal speech restrictions and its own views are the usual target.

strong-leader.rationale: Rejects state authority; communities are led by informal meritocratic influence rather than a leader who bypasses gridlock.

state-harmful.rationale: Calls state hierarchies systematically oppressive and wants nation-states, EU and UN replaced by autonomous communities.

limit-guns.rationale: Endorses armed struggle, urban guerrilla tactics and decentralized self-defence, opposing state disarmament.

empower-police-military.rationale: Anti-statist; state police and military are part of the apparatus to be dissolved.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Traditionalist communities but no state to legislate; Southgate disclaims regulating private conduct outside them.

decide-locally.rationale: Central tenet: political, social and economic decentralisation to autonomous village communities.

rehabilitation.rationale: No documented penal philosophy; communal self-governance without state prisons is implied but not specified.

traditional-family.rationale: Traditionalist and anti-feminist communities in the Evolian mold, excluding feminists and opposing homosexuality.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Opposes homosexuality and would exclude gay people from its communities.

abortion-legal.rationale: Southgate's vision included opposition to abortion as part of a natural-law traditionalist order.

more-religion-public.rationale: Rejects Christianity for neopaganism and mysticism, with communities free to follow their own religion; religion is not a state matter.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Rejects egalitarian anti-racism and advocates ethno-pluralism and racial separation.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Calls feminism dangerous and unnatural and appeals to natural order and innate hierarchy.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Preserving ethnic cultural continuity is stated as a reason for separatism, though expressed through tribe rather than nation-state.

gradual-change.rationale: Revolutionary, with clandestine cells and talk of revolt against the modern world; not respectful of existing institutions.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Opposes immigration and miscegenation as part of racial separatism.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Southgate, quoted by Connexipedia, wants 'all bureaucratic concepts such as the UN, NATO, the EU, the World Bank' eradicated and replaced by autonomous village-communities.

free-trade.rationale: Anti-globalist, anti-neoliberal, favoring self-sufficient communities, though free trade zones by agreement are allowed.

nation-first.rationale: Rejects the nation-state, but is not cosmopolitan; communities put themselves first. Inferred from separatist localism.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Anti-statist, anti-NATO and separatist; states intervening abroad is rejected. Inferred from these principles.

open-borders.rationale: Rejects multiracialism and supports segregated colour blocs and closed communities.

limit-growth.rationale: Claims ecologically sustainable communities and attacks capitalism, consumerism and materialism, drawing on green primitivism.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Environmental claims are made against capitalism and the state, but drastic government action contradicts anti-statism.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Anti-modern, drawing on Evola and primitivism, and hostile to GM food and cloning.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Not addressed; inferred from anti-modern, green-primitivist leanings and localism.

revolution-justified.rationale: Endorses propaganda of the deed, war of liberation and revolution against the modern order.

experts-over-public.rationale: Communities described as politically meritocratic, but technocratic state expertise is rejected.

central-planning.rationale: Anti-statist and favors decentralized self-sufficient communities.

socialized-markets.rationale: Mutualist and guild economies with common ownership overlap this, but it is not framed this way.

land-value-tax.rationale: Taxation is a state function; inferred from anti-statism, and the idea is not discussed.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Inferred from rejection of the taxing state; heritage and kinship are valued.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Wants economic self-sufficiency by communes, not state tariffs; inferred.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Connexipedia says National-Anarchists reject fascism and communism as statist and seek village-communities that have seceded from the state's economy altogether.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Promotes smallholdings, allotments and distributist wide ownership in local counter-economies.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Favors barter and local exchange systems but not abolition of money; not stated.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Anti-finance and anti-state, and local exchange trading replaces central money; inferred.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Guild-style bodies appear in Southgate's distributism but not state-recognized ones, as he rejects the state.

one-party-rule.rationale: Rejects the state; though the NRF itself had a Leninist cadre structure, it does not want a ruling party.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: Evola-style traditionalism looks to a medieval imperium, but hereditary rule is not stated; stateless ideal.

democracy-best.rationale: Rejects parliamentary democracy; favors direct popular rule and Evolian self-rule by an elite.

direct-votes.rationale: Macklin notes direct popular rule drawn from Qaddafi's Green Book, but Evolian elitism pulls the other way.

workers-councils.rationale: Rejects Marxism and class politics, though it shares decentralized council-like structures; communities are ethnic, not class based.

right-to-secede.rationale: Secession is central: autonomous communities secede economically and politically.

natural-rulers.rationale: Endorses an aristocratic spiritual elite and racial hierarchy, with meritocratic influence.

political-violence-never.rationale: Endorses propaganda of the deed and armed struggle, though Southgate later moved away from guerrilla tactics.

war-builds-character.rationale: The political-soldier ideal and Evolian warrior ethos suggest it, but not directly stated.

separate-church-state.rationale: There is no state; religious matters are left to communities.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Rejects Judeo-Christianity and Abrahamic scripture; invokes natural law and pagan tradition instead.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Stateless communities would provide their own policing and defense, which is not market-based but compatible.

military-superiority.rationale: Opposes nation-states and military alliances; states competing for superiority is not an aim.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Racial separatism and ethnic communities are core tenets, though organized as tribes rather than a nation-state.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Rejects Marxist class war and holds that distributism would end it, treating race and tradition as basic.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Ethnic communities on ancestral land fits it, but the statement is usually meant of non-European indigenous peoples; inferred.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Rejects egalitarian redress and a state apparatus that could pay; antisemitic and anti-liberal framing.

civilizational-union.rationale: Southgate speaks of a pan-European framework but via decentralised regions, not political union.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Emphasises community and tribe; the Anarch is individually sovereign but not a market egoist.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Traditionalist communal order and the political-soldier ideal outweigh universal individual rights.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Evokes a natural order and organic balance of nature, with Schelling's nature as visible spirit.

limit-population.rationale: Environmental rhetoric exists but racial rhetoric about demographics pulls opposite; no stated stance.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Draws on Hunt's anarcho-primitivism, Kaczynski and Evola's revolt against the modern world.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Anti-modern and primitivist, hostile to disruptive technological change.

human-enhancement.rationale: Opposes human cloning and GM technology as unnatural.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Rejects centralized government of any kind, and anti-modern.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Clandestine cells and anti-state posture imply it; not explicitly stated.

restore-past-order.rationale: Seeks a return to medieval organic community and Evola's primordial tradition, but through revolution.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Strongly ideological and doctrinal, Evolian and Traditionalist.

direct-action.rationale: Propaganda of the deed, clandestine cells and direct action preferred to elections.

means-match-ends.rationale: Leaderless resistance and autonomous cells are presented as consistent with the decentralized society sought.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Hunt's anarcho-primitivism implies a hunter-gatherer ideal, which Southgate adapted into rural back-to-the-land tribes, though not all adherents go that far.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Self-sufficient communes rather than abolishing specialization; not discussed.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Common ownership in guild communes within a tribe, but no stated principle of distribution.

production-for-use.rationale: Self-sufficient local economies aimed at community needs, inferred from anti-capitalism.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Anti-capitalist but blames financiers and Zionism rather than class exploitation of workers.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Macklin describes the NRF agenda as explicitly anti-Marxist, opposed to 'Marxist servitude', and Connexipedia says it rejects communism as statist and totalitarian.

collective-farming.rationale: Smallholdings and allotments alongside collectively maintained land; adherents not clear.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Anti-capitalist and expects collapse but links war to financiers rather than to an inevitable system; unclear.

taxation-theft.rationale: Anti-statist, so taxation is rejected; not stated in these terms.

harm-principle.rationale: Communal norms enforce traditionalist exclusion, while claiming to avoid force on outsiders; harm principle not adopted.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Rights and belonging are collective, based on tribe and kinship, rejecting liberal individualism.

conscription.rationale: Opposes state power; communities rely on voluntary association.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Southgate says people who want no part of an inclusive society will opt out; secession and voluntary association emphasised.

state-as-business.rationale: Rejects the state altogether rather than reforming it as a business.

positive-liberty.rationale: Anarch ideal emphasises self-mastery, not material provision; communal ownership partially overlaps.

media-academia-power.rationale: Conspiratorial anti-elite stance suggests it; not explicitly stated.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Racial purity and spiritual racism with a racial hierarchy are core tenets.

organic-representation.rationale: Organic community, guilds and kinship-based communities fit; Southgate's romantic organic state.

total-state.rationale: Connexipedia says National-Anarchists distance themselves from fascism and communism as statist and totalitarian, and want even nation-states eradicated.

national-rebirth.rationale: Seeks rebirth through revolt against modernity, though of tribe and race rather than nation.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Separatist diplomacy with no desire to pull others into its trajectory.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Medieval imperium and big-man leaders with informal authority suggest it, but not stated.

bound-labor.rationale: No stated stance; communal rural life but not legal bondage; voluntary association emphasised.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Evola-style esotericism and conspiracy claims, but no stated epistemology.

universal-morality.rationale: Rejects universalism and Judeo-Christian morality as slave morality; ethnic mysticism instead.

single-common-good.rationale: Southgate speaks of a tribal multiverse of different communities, each with its own principle, not one common good.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Macklin reports the NRF wages a 'war of liberation' against 'international Zionism' and its members burned Israeli flags outside Downing Street.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Ethno-pluralism might endorse diaspora return but nation-states are rejected; no stated stance.

revive-national-language.rationale: Cultural continuity valued, but language revival through the state is not discussed.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Guild co-ownership leans yes, but no stated position.

school-vouchers.rationale: State-funded schooling is rejected in a stateless order; inferred.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Rejects the state economy altogether; question presupposes state fiscal policy.

economic-freedom.rationale: Opposes capitalism and neoliberalism; political freedom is communal and not tied to markets.

rule-by-example.rationale: Informal leadership by moral authority and meritocratic big men, per the Anarch ideal.

national-self-determination.rationale: Ethnic self-determination is central, but via autonomous communities rather than nation-states.

force-without-un.rationale: Rejects both the UN and state military adventures; inferred.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Draws on mysticism, the occult, Jung and Evola; rejects rationalist modernity.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Welfare is not state-based; communal membership by ethnicity effectively restricts benefits.

work-for-welfare.rationale: No state welfare; communal self-sufficiency, not addressed.

class-collaboration.rationale: Distributism and guilds were said to end class war and unite producers in one community.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Traditionalism and cultural continuity oppose sacrificing heritage.

dominated-front.rationale: Anti-Western-power rhetoric exists in some strands, but no stated stance.

workers-nation.rationale: Anti-Marxist internationalism but also anti-nation-state; no stated stance.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Traditionalist and anti-feminist; but not enforced by law as there is no state.

ban-interest.rationale: Anti-finance and distributist heritage suggest hostility to usury; not directly stated.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Wants racial separation but through voluntary communes without state law, so rejects law-enforced classification.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Rejects the state as oppressive, but not through a Marxist class analysis.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Opposes immigration and mixing; seeks separation rather than assimilation.

elite-replacement.rationale: Antisemitic conspiracy views and opposition to immigration and miscegenation; Great Replacement idea is consistent, though not directly cited.

national-mission.rationale: Separatist diplomacy rejects spreading its system to others.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Strongly anti-establishment and anti-state, attacking political and financial elites.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Racial purity and eugenic rhetoric appear in the milieu, but no stated position.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Opposes the state generally; accountability question not addressed.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Southgate, quoted by Connexipedia, wants even nation-states like England and Germany eradicated and replaced by autonomous village-communities, leaving no minimal state.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Opposes miscegenation openly, while claiming not to impose this on others.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Macklin says Southgate rejects 'moral' rights for Darwinian struggle and favours a racial hierarchy conditioned by 'genetics'.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Not a Marxist ideology; no relevant position.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Not addressed; inferred ambivalence given anti-state and ethnic land claims.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Rejects a uniform state law; wants plural communities with own rules.

restrict-conversion.rationale: No state to legislate; communities set their own norms.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Hostile to vivisection but no cattle position; inferred.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: No state schools in a stateless order; not addressed.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Connexipedia describes the movement as anti-statist and rejecting communism as statist and totalitarian, so a strengthened socialist state is rejected.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Voluntary association is emphasised, though not formulated as legitimacy by consent.

trade-surplus.rationale: Aims at self-sufficiency, not mercantilist export; inferred.

population-transfer.rationale: Ethno-pluralism and segregated colour blocs involve removal or separation of ethnic groups, though methods vary.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Social Darwinist hierarchy in places, but anti-capitalist; no stated stance.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Party bans are not discussed; as an anti-statist movement working to overthrow the British state, it clearly would not grant the state this power.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Anarch sovereignty resembles it, but no stated formulation.

separated-powers.rationale: Rejects a state to divide; decentralised communities instead.

vanguard-party.rationale: The NRF was Leninist in structure with a cadre, but the leaderless resistance strand cuts against it.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Not a stated principle; communal mutual aid within the tribe only.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Labor law is a state matter and the sources record no position on strikes.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Blames capitalism and the state, not population; inferred.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Opposes multiracialism and argues for ethnic separate communities.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Informal meritocratic leaders, not lottery; inferred.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Rejects the state and its emergency powers.

party-commands-army.rationale: Rejects the state; no ruling party army.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Citizenship is not a category in this ideology; communities would be ethnically closed.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: The NRF cadre was disciplined, yet leaderless resistance resists it; not addressed.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Southgate, quoted by Connexipedia, lists the EU among the bureaucratic structures to be eradicated in favour of autonomous village-communities.

clerical-rule.rationale: Rejects Abrahamic religion and priestly rule; neopagan.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Anti-state and revolutionary, but not a class view; inferred.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Opposes state; communal norms may exclude but not via censorship.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Rejects elected presidents and state offices.

recall-officials.rationale: Rejects parliamentary politics; local direct rule might include recall, not stated.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Smallholdings favoured but no stance on rent.

people-in-arms.rationale: Armed citizenry and decentralized defence fit its guerrilla and anti-state outlook.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Southgate favours rural autonomous communities and back-to-the-land life.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Wants breakup of nation-states into regions, not reunification.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Endorses racial hierarchy yet frames separatism as difference; Evola-style spiritual racism.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Antifeminist and traditionalist; opposes state schooling.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Neopagan, not creationist; no state schools.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Traditionalist but no state law; unaddressed.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Descent and kinship define belonging, though without a state.

minority-language-support.rationale: Cultural autonomy but not state support; no stated stance.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Communities set own rules; no general laws.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Excludes feminists and homosexuals from traditionalist communities, though the Anarch is individual.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Anti-finance and anti-state; rejects central banks.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Ethnic land claims, but nation-state diplomacy rejected.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Distributist and guild common ownership imply property is subordinate to the community.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Rejects Marxism and state alike; no stated stance.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Environment rhetoric but no state regulation.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: The sources record no position on annexation or occupation law.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Rejects the state; no policy on clergy.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: No state or head of state.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Connexipedia says National-Anarchists aim to found village-communities seceded from the state and ally with secessionist movements worldwide.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Autonomy with own system fits decentralised regions, but joining a larger state is not sought.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Evolian sacred kingship appears in traditionalism but not as the NA position.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Rejects the state taxing at all.

character-from-environment.rationale: Hereditarian and racial-spirit views hold character is innate.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Anarch sovereign individual, but not rulers above law; no state.

leader-cult.rationale: Anarch ideal and leaderless resistance oppose state leader cults, though the NRF praised charismatic figures.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Rejects Marxism and class analysis, so socialist-state class struggle is not a frame it uses.

land-redistribution.rationale: Distributist land spread among small owners suggests yes, but no stated policy.

refugee-return.rationale: The sources record no position on refugee return; ethnic homelands are valued but not discussed in these terms.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Wants ethnic communities but not state expansion; rejects states, so unclear.

women-must-cover.rationale: No state law; neopagan rather than Islamic.

common-currency.rationale: Opposes EU and finance; local exchange systems instead.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Pan-European framework mentioned but via decentralised regions.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Autonomous cultural communities fit, though they would seek physical separation.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Macklin says Southgate's movement opposed the 'twin materialistic poles' of capitalism and Marxism, and seeks a spiritual reinvigoration of the West through 'spiritual racism'.

ban-cartels.rationale: Anti-concentration of economic power, but via the state is rejected; unclear.

no-bailouts.rationale: Anti-finance but no state; no stance.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Rejects liberal democracy but not majoritarian in the usual sense.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Quotas are not discussed, but Southgate calls feminism 'dangerous and unnatural' and the movement rejects state mandates, so parity rules are clearly opposed.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Communities are to be economically self-sufficient, with free trade zones by agreement.

moral-incentives.rationale: The sources record no position on work incentives under communal economies.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Propaganda of the deed and urban guerrilla theory were endorsed, though Southgate later disavowed it.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Evolian elitism and aristocratic spiritual elite.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Tradition and ethnic cultural continuity; inferred.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Separatist diplomacy and ethno-pluralism reject ruling other peoples.

patriotic-education.rationale: Teaches tribal identity but no state schools.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Opposes racial equality policy, though would reject the state mechanisms.

delink-world-market.rationale: Self-sufficient communes and anti-globalism favor delinking.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Voluntary association and freedom to form exclusive communities, with segregation and exclusion defended.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Macklin says the NRF abandoned the 'constitutional' approach and bases itself on Darwinian struggle rather than 'moral' rights; Connexipedia lists liberalism among causes of decline.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: The sources record no position on colonial-era treaties; ethnic autonomy is favored but not argued on these grounds.

elective-rulers.rationale: Informal meritocratic leadership, not election or inheritance.

minority-veto.rationale: Voluntary association and secession give effective individual consent; not formulated so.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Opposes vivisection and courts animal rights activists, though instrumentally.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Self-sufficient rural life implies animal use; no stated detail.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Aristocratic spiritual elite and organic community duty; inferred.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Back-to-the-land withdrawal and exit from mass society, with Anarch distance from politics.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Endorses propaganda of the deed and armed struggle, and the milieu treats force as legitimate, even though communities claim not to impose on others.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Inferred from Evola-style hostility to consumer modernity and mass culture.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Inferred from the movement's critique of the system's cultural control.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Inferred from the movement's anti-capitalist, anti-globalist stance.

native-born-offices.rationale: Inferred: communities would be ethnically defined, though no state offices exist.

party-own-road.rationale: Inferred from autonomy of each community and rejection of external direction.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Self-sufficient autonomous communities are central to the proposal.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Inferred: the movement rejects nation-states and their territorial claims.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Inferred from ethnic separatism and support for tribal autonomy.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: The movement is documented as a far-right current and rejects liberal state orthodoxies; inferred.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Inferred from its opposition to all statism.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Not addressed; adherents are not documented as taking a side.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Inferred from the traditionalist reverence for heritage.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Inferred from the movement's traditional gender views.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Southgate's tribal multiverse has each people develop its own forms of life and governance.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Inferred from opposition to the state and its institutions.

paid-care-work.rationale: Inferred from rejection of state wages and traditional gender roles.

filial-duty.rationale: Evolan traditionalism and tribal community life stress duties across generations; inferred from that, as the movement has no explicit family-law text.

office-by-exam.rationale: Inferred from its rejection of the state and of liberal democracy; selection would be by community and tradition, not state examinations.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Opposes the state and globalist capital alike, so it has no state policy on takeovers; adherents want local self-sufficient economies, which neither endorses nor requires state blocks.

no-fault-divorce.rationale: Inferred from traditionalist, family-centred communities that would likely keep marriage binding by custom; the movement has little explicit divorce doctrine.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Inferred from its call for small autonomous self-governing communities, where leaders answer directly to members; it has no explicit doctrine on recall.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Opposes both the state and global capital, so state-run and corporate-managed pension schemes alike conflict with its communal self-sufficient economy; mutual community support is inferred.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Inferred from its distributist and primitivist roots and its communes of self-sufficient land-holding groups; private speculative ownership is disfavoured.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: Rejects the state and parliamentary democracy, so a legislature controlling a national budget is not part of its model; inferred from anti-statism.

single-official-language.rationale: Wants ethnically and culturally distinct communities each keeping their own tradition, so a single state language imposed on all conflicts with its separatism; inferred.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Inferred from its ethnic separatism and communities holding their own territory; land would remain with the community, not be sold to outsiders.

disparate-impact-discrimination.rationale: Its ethno-pluralist separatism rejects the egalitarian anti-discrimination framework; inferred from its racial-separatist position.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Its anti-capitalist, anti-globalist, traditionalist critique of modern consumer society is central to the strand; stated in general terms in the sources.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: No stated policy; adherents oppose the state and global powers, and national-anarchism has no state to arm anyone, so adherents are split on the idea.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Rejects imperial blocs and the state itself, and favours each community deciding its own affairs; inferred from its autonomy principle.

corporate-influence.rationale: The movement opposes capitalism and global corporations, so adherents would likely say they hold undue power; inferred.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Opposes the state, so restricting by government fits poorly, but it rejects foreign influence on communities; split.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Opposes state incentives; adherents would rely on community-led reproduction, though they favour high birth rates in their groups; inferred.

residents-only-property.rationale: Autonomous communities are meant to keep land and homes for their own members, so limiting purchases to residents fits.

job-guarantee.rationale: Opposes state employment and central planning; inferred from anti-statism.

democratic-peace.rationale: Rejects liberal democracy and the idea that spreading it makes peace; inferred.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Anarchist rejection of the state means no duty to obey laws as such.

non-intervention.rationale: Opposes interference by states and international bodies in separate communities; inferred, but the position is not stated for all cases.

industrial-unions.rationale: Southgate's model uses communities defined by tribe, not industrial unions; inferred.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Scholars document antisemitic and conspiratorial currents in the milieu; low confidence because the movement presents itself as separatist.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Anarchism opposes state-recognised marriage; the movement is traditional on family, so it is inferred and split.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Opposes the state, yet adherents would not value legal rights against it; inferred and split.

local-production.rationale: Southgate's romantic and distributist outlook favours self-sufficient local economies.

informal-organisation.rationale: Documented as organising in small autonomous cells and tribal communities rather than permanent parties or unions.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Rejects international law and courts entirely, and local autonomy over national law; inferred, and national law itself is opposed.

religious-nation.rationale: The movement defines community by ethnicity and tradition, but explicitly allows varied faith communities.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Southgate rejects the state and hierarchical imperial arrangements, so deference of weaker states to a leading power runs against decentralised separatism.

regional-revenue-retention.rationale: Self-sufficient communities that keep what they produce fit the movement's localism, though it has no fiscal doctrine; inferred.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: The movement favours distributism and communal land, but has no doctrine on the personal/productive line, so this is split.

defeat-communism.rationale: The movement is far-right and hostile to Marxism, but also anti-capitalist and has no state to defeat anything; scholars still place it in the radical right; inferred.

mixed-public-service-providers.rationale: Services are meant to be handled by self-sufficient local communes, not by a publicly funded system with mixed providers; inferred.

religion-illusion.rationale: Evola-influenced traditionalism treats religion and spiritual tradition as a lasting human truth, not an illusion that fades.

capitalism-progressive.rationale: The movement is anti-capitalist, seeing capitalism as destroying traditional community; inferred from its rejection of the market order.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: The movement's traditionalism holds that sex roles are natural and rejects the view that equality needs economic change; inferred.

socialized-care.rationale: It favours family and tribal community; care would be done in the commune, not as a state public service; inferred.

purge-loanwords.rationale: The movement has no stated language policy; ethnic separatism might favour linguistic purity, but this is split.

treaties-binding.rationale: Anti-statism and ethnic separatism imply no commitment to treaties between a state and internal nations, and the movement seeks to dissolve states; inferred.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Self-sufficient autonomous communities holding land in common are the movement's central proposal.

majority-settlement.rationale: The movement wants separate ethnic communities and opposes state-engineered mixing, so state-promoted majority settlement runs against it.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: The movement explicitly presents itself as a third position beyond capitalism and Marxism, drawing on distributism and the National Revolutionary tradition.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Its ideal is ethnically or tribally defined homelands where each people lives on its own soil, so ancestral ties to land are central.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Adherents are split: some in Southgate's circle flirt with revisionism while others distance themselves; the sources do not give a settled movement position.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Inferred from anti-statism: communities would set their own mores and there would be no state criminal code, though traditionalist communes may still disapprove.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Opposes the state altogether, so a state suppressing opponents is the opposite of its vision of voluntary communities.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Inferred: with no state there is no civil government to punish blasphemy, although Evolan traditionalism values religious order within communities.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Rejects empires and nation-states alike in favour of separate self-governing tribes, so ruling territories for a metropole is rejected.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: Inferred: sympathetic to resistance against global powers, but an obligation on every Muslim is an Islamic doctrine the movement does not address.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Inferred from rejection of state rule in general, not from religious law; the movement has no doctrine on removing rulers by religious criteria.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Inferred from emphasis on direct self-governance in small communities, though it rejects egalitarian democracy and favours hierarchy within them.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Inferred: it rejects egalitarian and Marxist class-race-gender analysis and stresses hierarchy and ethnic separatism.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Inferred from traditionalist and Evolan views on sex and gender; being anti-state, it would not legislate recognition either way.

assisted-dying.rationale: The movement has no stated position; adherents' communal and traditionalist outlooks could point either way.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Presents itself as beyond left and right, combining anti-capitalism with traditionalism and separatism.

alienated-labor.rationale: Inferred from its anti-capitalism and distributist and primitivist influences, which criticise wage labour and industrial work.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Inferred from ethnic separatism and its stress on cultural homogeneity, though some adherents are sympathetic to Islam as a traditional faith.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Inferred: Evolan traditionalism looks to a sacred source of order, but adherents hold varied pagan, Christian and other beliefs.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Inferred: it has no state institutions to regulate dress, and each community would set its own norms.

ban-nda-harassment.rationale: Inferred: it opposes both corporate power and state regulation, so it has no stated view on legal limits on employers.

social-market-economy.rationale: Rejects both capitalism and the state, so a state-regulated market with social protection is not its model.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Inferred: it would abolish the state's military, but favours armed communal self-defence, so adherents are not clearly for or against.

rich-first.rationale: Inferred from its distributist and anti-capitalist economics, which oppose concentrated wealth.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Inferred from rejection of great-power blocs and global institutions in favour of separatist diplomacy among tribes.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Rejects the state and hierarchy of office, but its traditionalist and tribal strands could accept hereditary leadership within a community; inferred from anti-statism and Evolian traditionalism.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Inferred from its distributist and anti-capitalist economics and its preference for self-sufficient communal institutions over profit-making finance.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Inferred from its rejection of global institutions and its call for autonomous, self-sufficient communities outside international economic control.

property-franchise.rationale: Anti-state and there would be no state franchise at all; inferred from anarchism, and its communities are defined by ethnic belonging, not property.

domination-women-nature.rationale: Draws on green anarchism and primitivism against domination of nature, but its traditionalist gender views make a shared struggle with feminism unlikely; adherents split.

reification.rationale: Its anti-capitalism and Frankfurt-style cultural criticism are not clearly linked to the concept of reification; adherents have not addressed it, so this is neutral.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Inferred from its anti-capitalist, anti-globalist stance that treats mainstream media as controlled by hostile elites and its own outlets as marginalised.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: Anarchist rejection of the state's courts and legislation means no standing public law; inferred from anti-statism, with law replaced by community custom.

racial-franchise.rationale: Its defining program is ethnically and racially separate autonomous communities, each governing itself only for its own members.

online-participation.rationale: No stated position; its emphasis on local, face-to-face community suggests physical decision-making, yet it uses the internet and Substack heavily for propaganda.

open-government-data.rationale: No stated position; anti-statism makes it indifferent to government records, since it would abolish the state rather than reform its transparency.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Its ethnic and tribal separatism and traditionalism favour communities keeping their religious and cultural lines intact; inferred from separatism, not a stated law policy.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Its separatism favours in-group economic self-sufficiency but it does not centre on religious boycotts; no documented position.

citizens-assembly.rationale: Inferred from national-anarchism’s call for traditional, hierarchical tribal communities (Evola, distributism); a mixed lottery assembly is not part of its programme, though its anti-state localism and hostility to elected parliaments keep this mild.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: Inferred from its Evolian traditionalism, which holds that modernity severed people from a primordial tradition and seeks to restore it rather than update it to modern reason.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Inferred from its anti-capitalism and distributism, which favour small, self-sufficient holdings over concentrated wealth; the movement has little detailed policy.

open-lgbt-military-service.rationale: Inferred from its Evolan traditionalism and ethnic-communitarian focus; each community would set its own rules, but the movement's literature is hostile to gay rights.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Inferred from its traditionalist and pagan or religious-revivalist leanings; a state promoting atheism would also contradict its anti-state stance.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Inferred from its anti-statism: it wants the state's police and prisons replaced by community self-defence and local justice, though only as a loose aim.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Inferred from its call for ethnically separate autonomous communities rather than power-sharing in one mixed society.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Inferred from its stress on voluntary, self-reliant communal life in place of state welfare.

term-limits.rationale: The movement rejects electoral politics, so term limits are not a live question; inferred neutral.

vote-delegation.rationale: Inferred from its rejection of liberal democracy and mass voting in favour of tribal, traditional authority.

existential-risk-priority.rationale: The movement has no stated position; its green and primitivist strands pull one way and its disregard for global institutions the other.

women-in-religious-leadership.rationale: Inferred from its Evolan traditionalism, which favours a traditional division of religious roles.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: Inferred from its traditionalist, patriarchal view of family and gender roles.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: Inferred; the movement favours ethnically defined communities that control who lives in them.

rent-control.rationale: Inferred; the movement opposes state intervention and regulation.

abolish-ip.rationale: Inferred; its anti-capitalism and anti-statism give no clear position on intellectual property.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Inferred; the movement is anti-state and prefers voluntary community organisation to state-run youth drill.

no-nuclear-weapons-on-territory.rationale: Inferred from the movement's ecological and anti-state outlook.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: Inferred from Southgate's rejection of statism and rule by supranational powers.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Inferred; the movement rejects state authority and a historically framed recognition role.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: The movement draws on distributism and opposes capitalism and usury.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Inferred; the documented NRF positions accept violence.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Inferred from the Evolan traditionalist view of an ancient primordial tradition.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: Inferred from the movement's biological, race and gender essentialism.

no-fixed-category-of-women.rationale: Inferred; the movement rejects feminist politics and holds fixed roles.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Inferred from the movement's traditionalist, heroic ethos.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Evola's traditionalism sees the modern age as a spiritual struggle against decline.

homeland-cultural-centre.rationale: Inferred; each tribal community keeps its own territory rather than serving a diaspora.

culture-before-state.rationale: Southgate treats cultural and spiritual regeneration as the basis of the autonomous communities.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Inferred; the movement wants each community to run its own economy, not majorities dominating minorities.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Inferred from the proposal of a territory for each ethnic or tribal community.

independent-unions.rationale: Inferred: the movement is anti-state but favours organic hierarchy and tribal communities, so unions are not a defining concern.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Inferred: the movement defines the community by ethnicity and tradition, not class, and rejects Marxist class-centred politics.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Inferred: communities are self-governing and self-sufficient, so services are held locally, but whether publicly is not stated.

second-chamber.rationale: Inferred: the movement rejects the state and parliamentary government in favour of autonomous communities.

municipal-property.rationale: Inferred: the movement's distributist and communitarian roots favour community-held property and reject both capitalism and the state.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Inferred: the movement wants separate sovereign tribal communities, with diplomacy between them, not confederal coordination.

family-wage.rationale: Inferred: its traditionalism and distributism favour the family as the economic unit.

faster-drug-approval.rationale: The movement never addressed drug regulation, and its primitivist strand is sceptical of modern technology.

ageing-research-funding.rationale: Inferred: its primitivism and Evolian traditionalism are hostile to technological ageing research.

anonymous-payments.rationale: Inferred: the movement rejects the state and wants autonomy from it, which favours untraceable exchange.

online-anonymity.rationale: Inferred: opposition to state surveillance and control makes anonymity congenial.

person-over-state.rationale: The movement rejects the state and holds that the community and tradition, not the state, are central, but it also subordinates the individual to the tribe.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Evola's traditionalism and the movement's call to recover a primordial spiritual tradition make this central.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: Regional powers are not the issue; communities are held to be sovereign, which rejects the premise of a national legislature.

gm-crops.rationale: Inferred: its green anarchism and primitivism reject genetic engineering.

dense-cities.rationale: Inferred: its green anarchism and distributism favour rural, small-scale, self-sufficient communities.

racial-group-interests.rationale: The movement is built on racial and ethnic separatism, with each group's own community defending its identity.

racial-pride.rationale: Ethnic and racial identity and heritage are central to its tribal outlook.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: The movement rejects the state and its armies, but accepts defence by community militias and is not pacifist; the question is not addressed directly.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Defines communities by shared ethnic and tribal heritage, which overlaps with common language and history; inferred, as language is not singled out.

communal-electorates.rationale: Rejects the state and its electoral politics, so state-recognised religious electorates do not fit; inferred from anti-statism.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Opposes nation-states, so has no country to defend, yet its milieu is conspiratorial about global elites; no stated position.

free-public-college.rationale: Rejects state provision and favors self-sufficient local communities; inferred from anti-statism.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Opposes state taxation; its green-anarchist strand prefers local self-sufficiency to state-run pricing schemes; inferred.

future-generations.rationale: Draws on green anarchism, primitivism and traditionalism, which stress stewardship of land for later generations.

women-distinct-values.rationale: Evolan traditionalism favors separate gender roles rather than giving women's values more public weight; inferred.

arms-reduction.rationale: Favors armed, self-defending autonomous communities, so disarmament sits poorly; inferred.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Rejects state diplomacy altogether, so the question hardly arises; no stated position.

capital-controls.rationale: Anti-capitalist and anti-globalist but also anti-state, so state controls are unlikely; adherents unclear.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: National-anarchists reject the state and want armed, self-sufficient communities, so a state arms monopoly contradicts their position.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Southgate opposes the state and supranational wars but also accepts violence; no source states a view on soldiers refusing orders.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Rejection of the state and capitalism in favour of tribal communes implies no union-employer system; inferred, as the sources do not discuss unions.

in-work-tax-credits.rationale: Rejects state taxation and state welfare in favour of local community provision.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Opposes the state and its borrowing generally, but legal fiscal rules are not discussed; mild disagreement is inferred.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Wants the global economic order replaced by autonomous self-sufficient communities rather than restructured; inferred.

smash-state-machine.rationale: National-anarchists want the state and supranational bodies replaced by autonomous communities, though they do not use the Marxist formula.

free-economic-experiment.rationale: The movement proposes a tribal multiverse where each community picks its own economic and social order, with no blueprint.

nature-as-capital.rationale: Opposition to capitalism and a green, primitivist strand suggest scepticism of pricing nature as capital; inferred.

sacred-nation.rationale: Evola's traditionalism and the ethnic-community ideal treat the folk community as spiritual and enduring.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Rejects the state and its taxation, so state-funded student debt relief is opposed.

internal-colonialism.rationale: Not a central theme, but its anti-state localism rejects the idea of a central state as the unit; inferred.

shared-human-nature.rationale: Holds that racial and ethnic groups are essentially different and rejects universalism, and Evola's tradition opposes modernist redesign of humanity.

public-service-media.rationale: Rejects the state and its institutions, so state-funded public media are opposed.

missingStatements.text: Racial or ethnic groups should live in separate communities of their own.
missingStatements.rationale: Ethno-pluralist separation into tribal communes is the central proposal of national-anarchism.

missingStatements.text: The nation-state should be replaced by small autonomous self-governing communities.
missingStatements.rationale: Southgate wants nation-states and supranational bodies replaced by autonomous village-communities.

missingStatements.text: Modern society has cut people off from a primordial spiritual tradition that should be recovered.
missingStatements.rationale: Evola's revolt against the modern world and Primordial Tradition underlie the movement.

notes: Scholars (Macklin, Griffin, Sunshine) regard the anarchist label as opportunistic and the core as fascist or white nationalist; adherents deny coercion and stress voluntary separation. Keith Preston's pan-secessionist strand would answer differently on race.
